judge_input.description:
- Fixed the particular issue in which the input was the thing that ended up appearing as null over inside of the Langfuse dashboard, and the specific service for which this whole thing was happening was GoogleLLMService
- Added in a fallback of its own, and the thing that this fallback goes right ahead and does is to make use of the adapter's own get_messages_for_logging(), doing that specifically in the case of the universal LLMContext
- Ensures that the conversion of the message format is one that ends up happening properly and correctly, and it does this for the Google/Gemini services in particular
- Handles the whole business of the conversion of the system message, taking it over into the system_instruction format that is wanted
- Also goes right ahead and additionally fixes up the serialization of the empty message lists as well ([] is now something that goes ahead and serializes correctly, the way it ought to)

This particular fix right here is precisely the thing that ends up ensuring that the Langfuse tracing is something which works correctly, and the services it works correctly for are the Google ones, and that holds true both for the ones that happen to be using OpenAILLMContext/GoogleLLMContext on the one hand and equally for the ones using the universal LLMContext on the other hand.
